cat > /workspace/dev/one.py <<'EOF'
import sys, random, json
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/dev'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/project')
import fuzz, ref, harness
seed=int(sys.argv[1]); n=int(sys.argv[2])
rng=random.Random(seed)
bad=0
for it in range(n):
    cases=[fuzz.gen_case(rng) for _ in range(rng.randrange(1,4))]
    want=[ref.run(c) for c in cases]
    got=harness.solve(cases)['cases']
    for i,(g,w) in enumerate(zip(got,want)):
        out=[]
        fuzz.diff('c%d'%i,g,w,out)
        if out:
            bad+=1
            print('MISMATCH iter',it,'case',i,flush=True)
            print(json.dumps(cases[i])[:3000],flush=True)
            for p,gv,wv in out[:10]: print('   ',p,'got=',str(gv)[:160],'want=',str(wv)[:160],flush=True)
            json.dump(cases[i], open('/workspace/tmp/bad_%d_%d.json'%(seed,it),'w'), indent=1)
    if bad>4: break
print('done seed',seed,'iters',it+1,'bad',bad,flush=True)
EOF
